releaseNotes: STUDIO UPDATE CENTER — the Products tab is now a real update center for the WHOLE family: every Deadlock Studio app shows its FULL release history (each version, its date, and what changed) right inside the app, straight from the official OTA feed. No need to visit the site to know what's new.

UPDATE BADGES — every app card now wears a badge: UPDATE v-ready (red) when a newer build is out, UP TO DATE (green) when you're current, NEW for apps you haven't installed. A status strip on top sums it up: how many updates are ready, how many of the family you have installed, and when the feed was last checked — with a manual refresh button.

REAL APP ICONS — every product card now shows the app's actual launcher icon (Ophelia Widgets, Junk Cleaner and EasyPair included — composited from their real adaptive icons), not the studio placeholder.

The tab is renamed Products → STUDIO with a new family-grid icon, and every install row now says it out loud: sha256-verified — because every download IS hash-checked before the installer ever sees it. Cloning engine untouched — everything that worked in v1.8.0 works exactly the same.
